description.narrative: Support to the organization of the Paris Peace Forum.The Paris Peace Forum (PPF) was born in November 2018 from a simple observation: the current international system is unable to produce good political governance on issues that are critical to the well-being and, sometimes, the survival of people and the planet.The PPF¿s mission is to bring together key stakeholders (states, multilateral organizations, the EU and other regional organizations but also local governments, NGOs, companies, foundations and civil society at large) to improve governance frameworks and outcomes in selected sectors. The PPF¿s work supports multilateral institutions.  The PPF started as a major international event (four editions since November 2018) and a one-stop-shop for selected projects and initiatives that address global challenges. Since 2021, the PPF also operates year-round policy programs which build and activate multi-actor coalitions and initiatives.
